title: cleyera japonica var. tricolor
intro: Cleyera japonica var. tricolor, commonly known as the Tricolor Cleyera or Tri-Color Cleyera, is a variety of flowering plant in the family Theaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine and has been found to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Cleyera japonica var. tricolor include antioxidant, anti-diabetic, and anti-cancer activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
